roots.sain: SouthernShore frame with paid ports East then West; no Flow, Wind, comparison or event yet
roots.or: Introduce one fresh WaterFlow in the next written frame port; one identical slot operation at both occurrences
roots.aN: BindRecord: ground every variable of a paid Spec from explicit written bindings; emit immutable grounded record; never create participant/event/name
roots.COMPARE_GT: bare AIIN paid payload Greater(x,y); not a default for other aN forms
roots.opchdy: Push consumes grounded Greater(agent,patient) and preserves actual Flow identities
roots.qotor: SouthernImpact consumes that Push and explicit SAIN Shore; only two paid South cases
roots.sheedy: Generate one fresh Wind from performed SouthernImpact; source class follows only the two paid impact cases
roots.d: ReferentSpec(x) payload; x must be a written selected participant
roots.sho: within exact SHODAIIN only, select output of latest actually performed Generate event
roots.qo: within exact QODAIIN only, select patient of latest actually performed Push event
roots.olfar: Name literal Affricus, supplied separately after result binding
roots.ary: Attach supplied Name to the participant in the preceding bound ReferentRecord; generic naming, not special rejection of preexisting wind
roots.Affricus: source-specific Wind class and name atom, one literal identity, not two fitted aliases
roots.Nothus: source-specific Wind class/name atom; not an observed target binding

rules.R1: SAIN at paragraph entry creates only explicit SouthernShore and empty E,W ports; native seams retained, no line-reset state.
rules.R2: OR fills next unfilled port with a new WaterFlow; exactly two ports, explicit counted occurrences, no free ambient Flow.
rules.R3: BindRecord(Spec,bindings,evidence) substitutes actual written IDs, verifies sort and complete variables, freezes result; event-required specs require performed event.
rules.R4: OPCHDY creates Push(P,greaterFlow,otherFlow) from bound comparison.
rules.R5: QOTOR creates Impact(I,South,side) from P; source facts only E>W -> W side, W>E -> E side.
rules.R6: SHEEDY performs Generate(G,I) and creates fresh Wind w; paid Impact(S,W)->Affricus class, Impact(S,E)->Nothus class.
rules.R7: Finite exact D/SHO/QO selectors choose current participant/generated output/pushed participant respectively; absent actual argument is a barrier.
rules.R8: OLFAR writes Name(Affricus); ARY writes Names(boundRef.participant,Name), preserves exact identity and accepts any named Referent sort.

manual_trace: Frame F1; Shore s1=South; ports [East,West] empty.
Fill East port with fresh WaterFlow e1.
Fill West port with fresh WaterFlow w1.

SHO selects out(G1)=v1; D supplies Referent(x); same R3 binds {x:v1}, evidence G1 -> reference B1(v1).
Write name n1=Affricus, separate from G1 and B1.
Names(B1.participant=v1,n1), generic naming of the actual derived identity.

rivals.preexisting_wind: An independently paid initial Wind z1 of the same class can be generically named Affricus too. ARY is not made Wind-output-only to reject it. Actual trace provenance differs, but observed naming has no independently bound ancestry discriminator.
rivals.whole_case_lookup: Two separately paid source whole-case records can fit the source pair; the manual composition trace does not disprove them.
rivals.hydraulic_patient: Generic naming could also name a Flow. Source states a produced Wind, but no Voynich-owned type observation chooses this over a hydraulic story.

minimal_falsifier.operational: Under frozen R3/R7, attempt actual N DAIIN or E DAIIN only with written preceding arguments. Unbound cursor or absent performed event blocks execution; do not supply a default or rename unknown as a noun. This work finds missing arguments, not a contradiction of a confirmed meaning.
minimal_falsifier.counterfactual_source: Changing comparison E>W to W>E under the paid finite cases changes patient w1->e1, Impact side West->East, Wind class Affricus->Nothus. Target OLFAR remains an explicit Affricus literal; this is not a demonstrated second target branch or manuscript prediction.
